<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex02032025-04-2515-12-00" status="finalized"> 
 <milestone unit="section" n="ta2_sgrub pa bzhi so sor bshad pa"/>
 gnyis pa so sor bstan pa la bzhi las | 
 <milestone unit="section" n=" tha1_go cha'i sgrub ba bshad pa"/>
 dang po go cha'i bsgrub pa ston pa las <choice><orig>'tshams</orig><reg>mtshams</reg></choice> <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="107a5"/> sbyor gyi sgo nas sa mtshams ston pa las | 
 <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294"><note type="gloss">chos kyi bshes gnyend</note> khyung po<note type="gloss">s</note></rs> ltar na go rims ji lta ba bzhin bya ba yin pas | go cha ni sbyor laM | 'jug pa ni mthong <lb edRef="inst:6286" n="491"/> laM | <note type="gloss">bsgom °°°°°dang khyad par °°° <expan>gnyis su</expan> ° | dang po ni °°°</note> tshogs ni sgom laM sa bdun pa man chod | nges par 'byung ba ni sa brgyad pa'i khyad par gyi laM mo zhes bshad <note type="gloss">do 'o na <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3709">brgyad stong 'grel</rs> °° dang mi mthun no zhe na</note> nas | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3709">brgyad stong <note type="gloss">'grel</note> pa</rs>r ni gzhan <note type="gloss">thugs <expan>med</expan></note> gyi lugs brjod pa yin <note type="gloss">la °° lung gi ni rang lugs yin</note> pas mi 'gal lo zhes so || 
 <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="107a6"/> <note type="gloss">de dag ni rigs par °°° ji ltar rang bzhin la don <expan>med</expan> pa'i phyir dang | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3709">brgyad stong</rs> °°°°las bshad pa'i °°° rmongs pa'i phyir dang | des na bshad pa °° slob dpon gyi °°° ste | de lta ba yin na seMs kyi 'jug °°° laM las °°° dang | ° gyi tshigs kyang dang °°°° tshogs 'gal °° phyir ro | zhes °°°°</note> 
 de ni ma yin te <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3709">brgyad stong 'grel pa</rs> las rgyud pa dang rngos kyi sbyor ba zhes de gnyis su bshad pas 'di pha gi dang dgrig par nus pa'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
